items.html: However, the Guf of Adam was divided into two divisions, because Yesod de Bina expands until the Chazeh and the Orot inside it are covered. From the Chazeh down the Orot are uncovered, as we explain regarding the Hassadim that expand in Tifferet de ZA. For that reason his Guf was divided into two Olamot, the covered Upper half was placed in the last six of Yetzira and the revealed lower half was placed in the first four de Assiya.
